Local authenticated users that are conspiring with, or tricked by, a malicious federated homeserver can cause room aliases to have their destination room changed.

Homeservers that do not federate or only participate in a closed, trusted federation are not affected.

Homeservers that only have trusted local users are only vulnerable when a local user could be tricked into joining a malicious federated room.

### Patches

Update to Synapse 1.157.2 or later.

See the table below for patched versions of [Element Server Suite](https://element.io/en/server-suite), including Long-Term Support (LTS) versions.
|  | 25.10 LTS | 26.4 LTS | Latest |
|:--|--|--|--|
| **ESS Pro** | `25.10.14+lts` | `26.4.9+lts` | `26.7.2` |
| **ESS Classic** | `25.10.09-gui` | `26.04.04-gui` | ⸻ |
| **ESS Community** | ⸻ | ⸻ | `26.7.2` |
| **ESS TI-Messenger** | `25.10.10` | `26.4.5` | `26.7.0` |

### Workarounds

- Avoid joining untrusted remote rooms (rooms that the homeserver is not already part of).

### Identifiers

- ELEMENTSEC-2026-1729

### For more information
